notes.title: v0.03.00 released!
notes.content:
TOKYO DRIVE “v0.03.00” major update was released today!				
This update is mainly focused on visual improvements.				
				
The updated features and fixes are as follows				
				
(Major Updates)				
-Improvements to the appearance of the loading screen.				
-Display of passing vehicles (cars)				
-Visual improvement of rivers and oceans.				
(For rivers, only large rivers such as the Arakawa and Sumida Rivers are supported)				
-Car headlights on (at night).				
-Updating objects around roads and on the ground.				
(Including seasonal trees (such as cherry blossoms) arranged according to the date in the game)				
-Adjusting the display position of ground/roads and rivers/seas.				
(Fixed and improved issues where roads were displayed in rivers and oceans.)				

(Other minor changes)				
-Changing road textures.				
-We have made the in-game date progress faster.				
   (The date in the game now increases by the number of days that have passed since the game was last launched in the real world.)				
-(*Beta) Displays white lines and sidewalks on roads.				
  (*Still unstable. Normally disabled. Can be enabled from the options screen.)				

That's all.

notes.title: v0.02.00 released!
notes.content:
TOKYO DRIVE “v0.02.00” major update was released today!
This update is mainly to improve the display of buildings.

The updated features and fixes are as follows

(Major Updates)
-Improvements to the size and angle of buildings (to bring them closer to the real world)

In this game, buildings (with textures) are automatically placed in the game (different from reality) based on the location information of real buildings.
The size and angle of the buildings to be placed in such cases are now closer to reality.

notes.title: "Tokyo" continues to move.
notes.content:
It has been more than two months since the major update (v0.01) in January 2025.
Development is already underway for future updates.

We hope to address visual improvements as a priority in several future updates.
In the meantime, there will be more steady efforts such as visual adjustments, etc. 
This year, there may not be many announcements of additional features and other updates.

However, the development itself is continuing. 
We would like to announce that the development is continuing and our current efforts.


[Improvements to the size and angle of buildings (to bring them closer to the real world)] 
(currently under development, release targeted for 2025)

In this game, buildings (with textures) are automatically placed in the game (different from reality) based on the location information of 
real buildings.
We are planning to improve the size and angle of the buildings to be placed in this process so that they are placed closer to reality.
(Please refer to the image below)

Display a unique and special building at a particular location.
We believe this will help motivate people to visit a particular location.

(e.g., roads, street perimeters, etc.)

notes.title: v0.01.00 released!
notes.content:
TOKYO DRIVE “v0.01.00” major update was released today!
The updated features and fixes are as follows

(Major Updates)
-Adding functions for purchasing and transferring cars.
-Enhanced title screen presentation.
-Improvement of My Home Selection screen.
-Improvement of Fast Travel screen.
-Set WayPoint(destination), display distance and direction to WayPoint.
-UI enhancement of in-drive screen (Guide View).
-Collection elements (Discovery).
-Add manuals to the game.
-Listen to music during driving (classical music, etc.).
-Simple implementation of night views (lights of buildings and street lamps).
-Reduced processing dropout during drive.

(Other minor changes)
-Engine sound reproduction.
-Set a unique name for each type of car.
-Renewal of library images (library capsule).
-Expanded ability to adjust drawing process.
-Correction of some language settings that were not reflected correctly.
-Correction of time changes not being reflected during drive.
-Display of money in game on screen during drive.

notes.title: v0.00.02 Bug fixes and other releases
notes.content:
Fixed a problem in which events could not be started by pressing the Enter key.
Fixed that the menu can be operated with the arrow keys on the keyboard.
Fixed that race events were not displayed in areas other than Nerima Ward.
Displayed the direction (north) on the mini-map while driving.
